items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: We did the Basin Street with Bob Scobey’s band in New York and we played opposite Gerry Mulligan and Chet Baker.

ctx.x: We did the Basin Street with Bob Scobey’s band in New York and we played opposite Gerry Mulligan and Chet Baker.
That’s an interesting combination of bands.
